title: ConstantModulePushforwardLimit
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category in universe u, D:I -> Scheme a diagram with affine transition maps, p_i:D_i -> X compatible qcqs structure maps, and pi:Y -> D a limit cone with qcqs structure map nu:Y -> X satisfying pi_i followed by p_i = nu. For any commutative ring Lambda and module M in universe u+1, reverse I to form the diagram of p_i,* M_Di with the canonical maps of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-pushforward-functoriality]. Its cocone into nu_* M_Y given by the projections and those same canonical maps is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Tag 09Z1, degree-zero transition maps and continuity; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph, lines 12999-13008

proof.text: Present the explicit pushforward diagram K and its cocone c to the two continuity half-lemmas using identity isomorphisms eK_i and e. The diagram and component compatibility equations simplify by the identity laws and then are definitionally equal. Apply the injectivity half to obtain Mono(colimit.desc K c).
With the same diagram, cocone and compatibility proofs, apply the independent section-descent half to obtain Epi(colimit.desc K c).

The category of module-valued sheaves is abelian and hence balanced. A monic and epic morphism is an isomorphism, by CategoryTheory.isIso_of_mono_of_epi. Use (colimit.isColimit K).nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_desc to conclude that c is a colimit. The target statement, original docstring, and scheme hypotheses are unchanged.
